name: Milo Finch
title: Club junior
greeting: Am I up? Oh, you're playing. My mistake.
onWin: I actually won? The whole club needs to hear this!
onLoss: Nice game. Remind me which piece moves like a horse?

name: Hana Mori
title: Weekend regular
style: Calm and methodical, but overlooks distant threats.
greeting: Ready when you are. I made some tea.
onWin: That was lovely. Shame the tea's gone lukewarm.
onLoss: Right, I see it now. Everything in its place.

name: Elias Frost
title: Class C
style: Takes his time, seals the position, and waits for a mistake.
greeting: There's no rush. Winter is a long season.
onWin: You were the first to give in. Most are.
onLoss: The ice finally broke. Well played.

name: Lucia Vega
title: Class B
style: Makes the sacrifice first, then works out the details.
greeting: Stay out of the glare. Someone always has the sun in their eyes.
onWin: Take a seat in the shade and cool off before you return.
onLoss: Well! This old bronze still has some bite.

name: Jett Okoye
title: Class A
style: Quick fingers, surprising openings, and relentless clock pressure.
greeting: Drop a coin. Show me what you've got.
onWin: That's the end. The top score is still mine.
onLoss: All right, all right! Add your initials to the board.

name: Nia Lind
title: Expert
style: Builds strong outposts, targets weak squares, and squeezes slowly.
greeting: Every square remembers who left it undefended.
onWin: You left me a single square. That was all I needed.
onLoss: You protected every square. You have my respect.

name: Dr. Mira Solberg
title: International Master
style: Already knows how this endgame is likely to unfold.
greeting: Let's discover where the calculation takes us.
onWin: The answer was already in the analysis by move thirty.
onLoss: Impressive. I hadn't included that variation in my notes.

name: Rafael Conti
title: Grandmaster
style: Controls the eighth rank; no one has managed to get beyond him.
greeting: You've travelled quite a distance just to reach a pawn.
onWin: Back to the bottom. You can make the climb again.
onLoss: The eighth rank belongs to you now. Time to promote.
